model.name: featureManager.searchUsers
model.description: R31.8c NODE-1 (unblocks the c2 user selector) — FeatureManager.searchUsers(query) matches the query across userProfiles (name/phone/token) + alt-identity units (scenario/alt/phone|email|company: name/phone/email/uuid), resolves the user TOKEN, and returns [{token, name, avatar?, uuid?, identifiers[]}] with MASKED identifiers, RANKED exact->prefix->substring, capped-10 (flag-if-truncated). Owner-gated at the GET wrapper (requireOwnerHttp, INV-F4 — never leaks profiles to non-owners). mask/rank = private helpers. Singular-chain. Architect topology 8916e33a5.
